title: Effects of Gonadotropin Replacement Therapy on Metabolic Parameters in Patients With Hypogonadism
brief_summary: Effects of gonadotrophin replacement therapy Lipid Profile and Oxidative Stress Parameters of Patients with Idiopathic Hypogonadotropic Hypogonadism
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Serum testosterone concentration \< 300ng/dL Absence of a pituitary or hypothalamic mass lesions, Presence of gonadotropin response to GnRH, -

Exclusion Criteria:

diabetes mellitus, arterial hypertension other hormone deficiencies

study_population: Patients with Idiopathic Hypogonadotropic Hypogonadism and healthy control group
